findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-501.11: The gasket of the left double door cooler is observed in disrepair and held together with tape. This is not an approved method of repair. The gasket needs to be removed and replaced with a new one that creates a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface. 
4-501.11: (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in good repair. (B) EQUIPMENT components shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted to manufacturer’s specifications. (C) Cutting or piercing parts of can opens shall be kept sharp to minimize metal fragmentation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: There was observed a few old mouse droppings in the dry storage closet. PIC was made aware and immediately cleaned and sanitized the surfaces with the old droppings. Ensure these areas are observed and cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The ground fans in the kitchen are observed to have an accumulation of dust/soil residues. Ensure the cage surfaces are maintained clean to not pose a contamination hazard to the surrounding surfaces in the path of the air.
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: There are fresh mouse droppings observed in the dry storage of the facility. There are mouse traps and glue traps present. Facility needs to clean the drippings out from under the shelving to better monitor the pest issue and determine the extent to which the mice are present. A 10 day follow-up is being issued for 2/14/2023 to observe the cleaning and to observe progress in the pest eradication.
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The fans in the facility are observed to have an accumulation of dust/soil debris. Ensure these fans are cleaned and sanitized and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of dust/soil.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: There are observed under the triple sink and under the shelves in the dry storage old mouse droppings. Ensure that equipment is pulled away from walls if able and that the hard to reach areas of the kitchen receive attention to detail when it comes to cleaning.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: Facility is observed to have a mouse issue that maintenance is currently trying to eradicate. There was a reported mouse on the glue trap this morning and then mouse droppings were present in the dry storage and kitchen area.Glue traps are placed throughout the kitchen and dry storage, maintenance is routinely sweeping up the droppings. Facility must monitor the situation and continuously check food items for damage from rodents, no damage observed during today’s inspection. Ensure that droppings are removed from floor routinely to ensure accurate monitoring of issue. 
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: Observed the caulking by the triple sink and the dish machine to be degrading in quality and resulting in a slight gap between the metal and the wall. Ensure the caulking is replaced in order for the surface to be smooth, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable.
PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: Non-food contact surfaces such as the carts in the dry storage have what appear to be a few rodent droppings on them. District pest control operator was on site yesterday as reported by PIC and as evidenced by dates on new glue traps for routine treatment. He did not notify of any issues. This appears to be a cleaning issue rather than an active pest issue. Clean carts and any remaining droppings and monitor. Alert pest control as needed.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13  (C) Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the can opener blade to be soiled.  The blade was cleaned during the inspection. (IMMEDIATELY CORRECTED)
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed a small leak at the left faucet of three compartment sink.  Repair the leak.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
The dish machine rinse cycle water temperature reads 255 degrees on the digital readout.  Water cannot be more than 212 degrees (boiling point).  Have the temperature sensor or gauge adjusted or repaired so the readout is accurate.  (NOTE:  A temperature test strip was affixed to a cup and run through the machine to insure the final rinse water was hot enough to change the color of the strip - 180 degrees at the manifold).
750-830c A thermometer ±3°F shall be provided to check the temperature of  the water in each tank of the dish machine and the temperature of  the final rinse water as it enters the manifold.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
The food trays on the cart outside the kitchen were uncovered.  Cover the trays, invert them, or invert the top tray until ready to serve food.
750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Spoons, knives and forks shall be touched only by their handles.  Cups glasses, bowls, plates and similar items shall be handled without contact with inside surfaces or with surfaces that contact the user’s mouth.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
The floor drain below the dish machine was soiled.  Clean the drain.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
(A) The corner of the red top cabinet at the end of the steam table is chipped on the edge.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)   (B) The edge of the red top cabinet on which the can opener is mounted is chipped on the edge.   (C) The bottoms of the wood cabinets by the window are in need of refinishing.      (D) The shelves in the wood cabinets opposite the 3-pan sink are chipping and are in need of refinishing. (REPEAT VIOLATION)
Refinish / repair the cabinet tops and shelves / bottoms of the cabinets.     750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
The floor under the dish machine and around the floor drain to the left of the dish machine is soiled close to the wall.  Clean the floor.

750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
The wall behind and below the dish machine is lightly soiled. Clean the wall.

750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
A bulk sugar container in the tall wood cabinet opposite the dish washing area was not labeled as to its contents.
750-130f Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.
Label the container.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
The handles of the bulk sugar scoops (white and brown) were laying in the sugar.
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.
The scoops were stored with the handles up to CORRECT the violation.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
(A) A corner on the red counter top was chipped.
(B) Two shelves where chemicals are stored in the tall wood cabinet opposite the dish washing area have chipping surfaces. (VIOLATION 2X)
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.     Sand and seal the counter top corner and shelves so they are smooth, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable..

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
The under side of the big mixer in the dry goods storage room was soiled.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.
The mixer was cleaned to CORRECT the violation.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
A stack of paper food containers were stored food side up.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.
The containers were inverted to CORRECT the violation.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
A dead mouse was found on a glue board in the corner of the dry goods storage room under some wire shelves.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean.
The mouse was removed to CORRECT the violation.  NOTE: There was no evidence of mouse droppings in the dry good storage room.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text: 750.690 - A) Gaps around water lines and PVC pipe in the wall of the cabinet below the prep sink still need to be sealed. Seal all gaps and crevices inside the cabinets the island prep counter after the cabinets have been cleaned. B) Two shelves in tall cabinets (across from 3 part sink) used for chemical storage have damaged peeling surfaces. Repair or replace the shelves. Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - Cabinets at island prep counter observed to have dead adult, juvenile, and baby roaches inside. Thoroughly clean the cabinet and finish sealing all gaps and crevices inside the cabinets.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.citation_text: 750.1160 - Baby and juvenile roaches were observed scurrying from behind loose coving at the bottom of tall cabinets across from 3 part sink. Also, a dying female with an intact egg case was observed on the floor by the cabinets. Female was flushed down the toilet. All the coving at the tall storage cabinet needs to be removed. Along the cabinet and floor joint needs to be treated, and then the floor to cabinet juncture needs to be resealed. (see general comments)

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1200 & 1220 - Loose coving along bottom of tall cabinets needs to be removed so the area can be treated. Then the floor to cabinet juncture needs to be resealed. It might be better to use silicone to seal the juncture prior to replacing the plastic coving to eliminate crevices. **Check throughout the kitchen and repair or replace loose/damaged coving.** (see general comments)

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1210 - Some foam insulation remains on the lines to the dish machine and below the sprayer sink. Remove all foam insulation from the lines and leave insulation off until issue with roaches is under control. **Note: all insulation observed to be damaged during spot check on 12/4 has been removed and the pipes were free of roaches around the booster heater**

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text: 750.690 - A) Gaps were observed around water lines & PVC pipe in the cabinet below the prep sink. Also the edges of the Nudo board in the cabinet were loose. Seal the edges of the Nudo board and the gaps around the water lines & PVC pipe with caulk or another approved repair material (no spray foam). B) Two shelves in the tall storage cabinet used for chemical storage have damaged/peeling surfaces. Remove the damaged layer of wood and re-seal the shelves with clear sealant or paint so the shelves are smooth and easily cleanable. Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, easily cleanable, and in good repair.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - Dead roaches were observed in various cabinets throughout the kitchen. Clean the cabinets. Check cabinets daily, especially ones where dead roaches have been observed, and maintain them clean.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.citation_text: 750.1160 - Roaches at various life stages (adults, female with egg case attached, and babies) were observed around the booster heater at the 3 part sink. A baby roach was squished on the floor using a paper towel across the room by the 2 door cooler. Calls were made for maintenance worker and PCO to come out and discuss corrective actions/start addressing the issue.  Repairs need to be made to loose coving, damaged/cracked plumbing insulation needs to be removed, and area around booster heater needs to be treated and thoroughly cleaned. (see general comments and non-critical violations for further details)

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1200 & 1220 - A) Floor under/behind booster heater and along dish machine were soiled with debris. Roaches and egg cases were observed under the booster heater (see#35a). B) Plastic coving behind dish machine & garbage grinder was loose & had a gap in one area. Coving was also loose by the door to the dry storage room. Seal gaps and replace coving. C) Floor tiles under dish machine area starting to peel up in a few areas. Replace floor tiles to eliminate potential hiding places for pests. (see general comments for information regarding floor drain next to dish machine).

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1210 - Foam insulation around plumbing between booster heater and 3 part sink was observed to be damaged/cracked in some areas. The insulation in disrepair was providing a hiding place for roaches. Exterminator began cleaning the area and removing insulation that was severely damaged. Have a licensed plumber make all necessary repairs and remove the remainder of the insulation. Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.citation_text: 750.120 - Tator tots cooling uncovered in milk cooler were observed directly under ice accumulation. Ice began to melt/drip down on the tots. Tots were moved to another cold holding unit for the remainder of the cooling process. Once the tots have cooled to 41F/below then they may be placed back in the milk cooler as long as the tray is in a sealed, intact food grade storage bag. Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text: 750.690 - A) Foam mesh was observed in the cabinet below spatula storage at the small prep counter. Remove the foam mesh from the cabinet. B) Gaps were observed around water lines & PVC pipe in the cabinet below the prep sink. Also the edges of the Nudo board in the cabinet were loose. Thoroughly clean the cabinet (see #23) and then seal the edges of the Nudo board and the gaps around the water lines & PVC pipe with caulk or another approved repair material (no spray foam). C) Two shelves in the tall storage cabinet used for chemical storage have damaged/peeling surfaces. Remove the damaged layer of wood and re-seal the shelves with clear sealant or paint so the shelves are smooth and easily cleanable. Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, easily cleanable, and in good repair.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 750.800 - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) bottom inside milk cooler near the all purpose room (debris); B) general surfaces on the bottom of the dish machine (dust buildup); C) tall storage cabinets across from dish area (dead roaches); D) inside cabinets below small prep counter/prep sink (dead roaches); & E) lower cabinets along the wall by the 2 door cooler (dead roaches and old mouse droppings). Thoroughly clean all non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - The floors were observed to be soiled in the following places: A) dry storage room in corners below crouton storage and by the large mixer (old mouse droppings); B) along the wall in the dish area and below booster heater pipes; & C) under the 2 door cooler (moldy tomatoes and deli paper). Clean the floors daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris, which may serve as a food source for pests.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1210 -Soap dispenser in the restroom has been relocated to the left. The area in disrepair still needs to be painted. Kitchen Manager stated the painters are working on other jobs but will paint the wall in the restroom before the next inspection.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) (R) hood filters (dust buildup); B) edges around dish machine doors (buildup); & C) lower cabinet below red counter (dead roach). Clean the above items and all non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.citation_text: 750.1160 - One intact roach egg case was observed on the floor in the dry storage room below shelves holding single service items. Egg case was shown to Kitchen Manager before flushing it down the toilet. Case was not yet hatched, thus baby roaches were inside. No other intact egg cases were observed. No live roaches were observed. Contact your pest control operator (PCO) for service - have PCO come out next week for treatment. As spot check will be conducted in two weeks to check on status of pest control. Effective measures to minimize the presence of rodents and insects shall be utilized. (see general comments)

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - Floors were soiled in the dry storage room (debris, old mouse droppings, roach egg case) and under/behind milk cooler by door to all purpose room (debris). Clean the floors throughout along walls and under equipment daily/as needed. Change out glue traps regularly.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1210 - A) (R) Wall covering around soap dispenser in restroom has peeled away. On the left side tape has been placed over the area since last inspection. Damage on right side is new. Tape is not an approved repair material. Remove tape and use clear sealant or paint to repair the wall around the restroom soap dispenser. B) Caulk is starting to get worn at restroom handsink. Re-caulk the worn areas of the restroom handsink. C) Electrical outlet without a proper cover was observed next to the light switch in the dry storage room. Cover the exposed outlet.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.citation_text: 750.1160 - Box with junk and old dish machine equipment observed in dry storage room had old mouse droppings and roach egg cases (appeared to be hatched) in the bottom. A red bucket with old Christmas decorations had a dead roach in the bottom. Box of junk and old decorations were discarded in the outside dumpster during the inspection, and the red bucket was cleaned. The premises shall be kept in such a condition to prevent the harborage or feeding of insects or rodents. (see general comments)

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled: A) (R) dusty floor fan blowing toward food prep area & B) top inside microwave (dried food splash). Properly clean and sanitize the above items and all food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) underside of booster heater (cobwebs); B) bottom inside steam table around heating elements (crumbs/food splash); C) plastic tub holding graham crackers in steam table cabinet (food debris); D) hood filters; & E) inside cabinets below red counter along south wall (old mouse droppings). Clean the above items and all non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris. (see general comments)

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1210 & 1220 - A) Ceiling tiles in the restroom were acoustic. Replace ceiling tiles at next remodel with smooth cleanable tiles like those present in the kitchen. B) Wall covering has begun to peel away on the left side of the soap dispenser in the restroom. Repair the wall covering. C) What appeared to be old mouse droppings were hanging along the southeast corner in the dry storage room. Clean the walls in the dry storage room (see general comments)

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Floor fans and box fabs in the kitchen are dusty and blowing air over food prep areas. Wash, rinse and sanitize the fans.
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
THe ceiling tiles in the kitchen restroom are acoustic and not easily cleanable.  Upon next remodel, change to smooth, easily cleanable tiles.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: .1210) Ceiling tiles in the employee restroom are absorbent and not easily cleanable.  Replace the tiles with smooth, easily cleanable tiles at time of next remodel.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment: .1240) The light fixtures in the dry storage room are not shielded properly.  The fixtures haev extended sides but are not sufficient to provide total protection.  Place shields on fixtures or purchase shatter proof light bulbs.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text:
750.1210 - Ceiling tiles in restroom are acoustic/absorbent. Replace the tiles with smooth/easily cleanable tiles at time of next remodel.

**All ceiling tiles in kitchen have been changed out to smooth tiles since the last routine inspection.**

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment: Digital thermostat for dish machine was not registering a proper final rinse temperature - read 0F skipped between 3F & 122F and went back to 0F. Temperature test strip was used to verify the dish machine is reaching appropriate final rinse temperature (temperature test strip turned black & was left with print out provided for cafeteria staff). Get the dish machine thermostat checked/repaired so the proper final rinse temperature displays on the screen.

findings.comment: Floor drain between 3 compartment sink & dish machine does not have a cover. Provide a cover for the floor drain.
